thread:
priya: Quick Q  Im on OPT (EAD through Sep 2) and have an H-1B transfer pending. My partner needs to be added to benefits on day 1 because of ongoing medical care. If my stamping/approval slips past my offer start (Aug 15), can we still enroll my spouse retroactively?

maria (People Ops): Short answer: benefits require active payroll + I-9. Retroactive enrollment is possible only if docs are provided before payroll cutoff and legal signs off. Otherwise enrollment effective date is payroll start when I-9 is done.

priya: What exactly is payroll cutoff? I might be traveling for biometrics late July.

jordan (Payroll): Payroll cutoff is the 25th of each month for the following-month payroll. If we receive proof of authorization before the 25th, we can often set hire date to the original offer and make benefits effective retroactively. After the cutoff, it moves to next cycle.

priya: If I do "onboarding-only" (no pay) on Aug 15, can my partner get temporary coverage via Redwood plan until Im on payroll?

maria (People Ops): We dont enroll dependents for non-payroll users. Options: 1) retroactive enrollment (if docs hit cutoff in time + legal approves), 2) short-term marketplace/COBRA alternative, 3) manager-funded bridge in exceptional cases (rare). We can help connect to a benefits broker.

legal-bot: Note: for change-of-status filings, traveling abroad before adjudication can void COS claims. If youre doing consular processing, confirm with immigration attorney. Also, scanned approval PDFs can be used for remote I-9 but originals must be inspected by an authorized representative on first US day.

priya: Can Redwood accept the consulate receipt + I-797C for cap-gap to keep payroll active?

maria (People Ops): If cap-gap language is present on the I-797C and legal confirms eligibility, yes. Upload the receipt to the candidate portal and tag @maria so we can review.

priya: Any template for the consulate/travel letter?

maria (People Ops): Here's a short template you can paste into the consulate portal. Customize name/location; I'll sign and send a PDF.

```
To: Consular Officer
Subject: Employment verification for visa stamping
Name: Priya Menon
Position: Software Engineer, Full-time
Proposed start: August 15, 2026
Employer: Redwood Inference, Inc.
We confirm the above-named individual has a bona fide offer. For verification contact hr@redwood.com.
```

priya: Also  my manager needs laptop access day 1 for a training cohort. Can IT provision hardware before payroll?

it-ops: We can provide soft access (email, Slack, LMS) immediately. Physical laptop before payroll requires manager approval and is processed as an asset loan; cost center will be billed. For expedited provisioning, include manager approval in the candidate portal notes.

jordan (Payroll): Action items: 1) Priya upload passport, receipt/I-797/I-797C to portal. 2) Maria to review cap-gap eligibility with legal. 3) IT will hold off on laptop until manager confirmation unless asset loan requested.

priya: Uploaded EAD scan and premium receipt. Thanks all. I'll DM legal if I plan to travel during adjudication.

maria (People Ops): Got it. We'll tentatively set onboarding-only access for Aug 15 and hold payroll until I-9 originals are inspected or cap-gap docs are confirmed. If docs arrive before Aug 25 cutoff well try to backdate hire date for benefits; otherwise benefits will start the payroll cycle after authorization.
